purpose: Every standalone Towns & Towers Viking, Polish and Swedish piece with the taiga forts and towers, both complete CTOV taiga villages with the taiga outpost, the Dungeons & Taverns spruce tavern set, the vanilla taiga village and Kithkyn's original Village Life taiga family, for selecting the Taiga catalog.
worldNote: Placed in the trio test world east of the Mushroom gallery, with the void biome filled through every row's sky so no snow settles and lightning cannot strike.
selectionRule: Every standalone piece of the T&T Viking, Polish and Swedish villages and their outpost forts and towers; every standalone CTOV taiga and fortified taiga piece plus the taiga outpost, roads omitted and entities stripped, with other mods' blocks shown as neutral vanilla markers; every non-villager D&T spruce tavern module, the spruce well, the taiga castle ruin and firewatch tower; every vanilla taiga village piece but streets, villagers and zombie copies; and the original Village Life taiga family. Street, terminator and villager templates are omitted.
